item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 13/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong, and it will be very hot during the day in the next few days. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will still be a few showers over the region. The anticyclone aloft is expected to weaken in the latter part of this week. A broad area of low pressure will develop gradually over the seas east of the Philippines and bring unsettled weather to the region.
